defects: Specializes the gold's general setting (𝕜 : NontriviallyNormedField, E : NormedSpace 𝕜 E, f : 𝕜 → E) to the concrete case f : ℂ → ℂ, z₀ : ℂ, losing the generality of the gold statement.

Restructures the MeromorphicAt f x hypothesis from a separate precondition (hf) into a conjunct on the LHS of the iff, changing the logical shape of the theorem rather than keeping it as an explicit hypothesis as in gold.
